review_text: Gatwick to Preveza return with Small Planet Airlines Our flights both ways could not have been any smoother and the experience was faultless I didnt try the food so unable to comment but all the staff were friendly and attentive Would use again

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE

Avoid at peak times security is a mess Gone are the days of the minute check in and smooth easy journey This used to be my go to airport due to the ease of transit Such a shame they have added so much flight capacity and not matched it with security

Getting into Kinshasa is quite OK getting out is something else The airlines dontcant have their own staff at the terminal all the flights Kenya South African Ethiopian are handled by the same slow and unfriendly personnel There is now an official exit tax of plus a couple of minor unofficial ones Airport is gloomy very little seating nothing to do except worry about what is going to happen next VIP exit lounge while hardly Heathrow is clean and bright and you get a free drink well worth the extra Even if you speak French dont even contemplate going to Kinshasa unless your hosthotel sends a protocol to meet you at the airport and escort you out Be sure to stock up with US bills for unofficial taxes they wont take less and they dont expect more On a more positive note it is irritating rather than frightening and once youre through the airport everybody is pleasant and everything is fine

Siem Reap to Da Nang I purchased a flight without baggage I purchased baggage separately for AU with great difficulty via the Cambodia Angkor Air website I received the receipt on Messenger The receipt could not be located at Siem Reap airport I was forced to then pay US to get my luggage on board I have emailed the airline with the receipt and transcript but there has been no response On board I had never seen a refreshment trolley pushed along the aisle with such speed allowing nobody the opportunity to obtain a drink

I usually fly budget so dont expect too much Had my first flight with Mihin Lanka from Chennai to Colombo Plane was not new but Im glad the flight was only hour as the seats felt like they had lost all their padding The flight went smoothly except the Stewards did not offer any option to purchase refreshments It may seem unnecessary on a short flight except by the time you have got to the airport and followed all procedures a few hours have ticked over and some refreshments would come in handy Probably what concerned me most was the fellow passenger pouring a hot drink from his flask to his wife How did that get through security There was someone on his mobile phone as we were landing The other fellow who grabbed his luggage and made his way to the front door before the plane had stopped

Yangon International Airport has Terminals and for International Flights and for Domestic Flights This is the review for Terminal Domestic This Terminal is a new build and many upgraded from the old terminal The airport is very clean and you can find the checkin counter very easily After checkin the nd floor is for departure and the rd floor is for lounges The departure hall is very large and can buy goods and many restaurants which already open early morning am The gates numbers are easily to find

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too

On the understanding that Srinagar being the capital of Indian administered Kashmir is at the centre of one of longest running conflicts in the world then one should expect a particularly unique experience regarding airport security Srinagar airport in this respect does not disappoint On arrival on Jet Airways from Delhi one is immediately struck by the fact that this is a military airfield masquerading as a civilian airport MiG fighters and helicopter gunships abound at the far end of the airfield and all buildings are camoflauge painted The odd civilian Boening looks incongruous For arriving foreigners you are accosted by a security official fairly politely it must be said to fill in a long registration document He then accompanies you out of the arrival and baggage collection hall on a dirt track to the carpark to ensure you are being met by whoever you had claimed you were on the form Only then can you be on your way If you are not being met I am not sure what your fate would be Departure though is an object lesson in airport security The first hurdle is a kilometer or so before the airport terminal where you are stopped at a roadblock and put your luggage through an xray machine Entering the airport and only passengers are allowed not guests or friends you again put bags through another xray sceeening Then you are allowed to go to check in after which you must as a foreigner fill out another lengthy departure registration form for the police No hand luggage whatsoever is allowed on Delhi bound flights so all you can carry is what you can fit in your pockets therefore travel with a multipocket vest or similar to maximise carry on potential Hand carried clear plastic water bottles do suprisingly seem OK though to carry on The waiting area after check in is basic but OK as long as you dont mind being stared at suspiciously by numerous armed army and poice men Then there is another long queue for a more detailed security check which involves turning out all pockets and being individually scanned Finally you are through to the actual departure area but this is not the end After being released to go out on foot to your waiting Boeing you again go through another security check all pockets and a patdown before eventually you board the plane Great views of the Himalayas to the north on the flight out but since cameras are not allowed on board the memories stay in your mind and not on film
The new Delta Terminal C is elegant convenient and modern Restaurants gate areas and restrooms were all immaculate Checkin went smoothly Keep it up

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates

The airport was not busy when we arrived but this did not stop it taking minutes to pass through immigration and collect bags Facilities are what you expect from an airport about years out of date and did not expect anything different I guess Found the staff to be unfriendly and there were no painted on smiles available here

Arriving late at night from Brisbane on a delayed flight we were quickly off the plane and through customs without a long delay for baggage but remember PGK for a visitors visa Security is fairly tight due to the general problems of PNG and only passengers with tickets are allowed into the terminals The domestic terminal is somewhat more crowded and more confusing with limited facilities but is relatively clean Returning from outside POM you may well find that there is no international baggage transfer you need to walk the three hundred or so metres between the terminals with your baggage but it is a covered walkway with lots of security staff everywhere After checkin there is then a wait with few available chairs until customs is opened about an hour before the flight Once through things go fairly smoothly though there is not much airside apart from the small Air Niugini lounge which is pleasant enough For the size of Port Moresby a reasonable enough experience though more seating would be good

Unhelpful Disorganized Was on a layover from Amsterdam to Toronto Canada I arrived through KLM airlines but my luggage didnt When I asked about my luggage the luggage staff said they transferred it to my next flight which they dont do and my itinerary said baggage not checked through When I left luggage collection and went to the check in area I asked a staff member if they could confirm it was sent through and they said with certainty that they would not have transferred my luggage and to go check again I went back to check again but security would not let me back into the luggage area I told them the story and without even looking at my flight itinerary said it was transferred to my next flight I had no contact with this security officer before nor did they know anything about my situation prior Now to be clear its almost certain that KLM lost my luggage and its not the luggage handlers problem But for them to just lie about it to get rid of me is unacceptable They could have said it appears it didnt arrive and thats fine I cant blame them for that But I just essentially went back and forth between people in the airport not knowing who was telling the truth or who knows what theyre talking about I dont expect Mexico City airport to be the best airport in the world but to be an international airport that essentially has no centralized information center and to have employees who just lie to get rid of you is really unacceptable Im sure they dont get paid the most and I get that

Arriving in Manado from Singapore by SilkAir is always a good experience The greenery around the airport was beautiful and the short walk less than minutes from the plane to the immigration counter is a relief compared to the minute walk I used to have in Changi when rushing from immigration to the gate The terminal building is quite clean and adequate The only downside is the crowd outside the arriving gate exit There were lots of illegal taxis touting arriving passengers The lack of seating area outside the terminal is also a concern as it was hard to find a proper place to sit while waiting for someone to arrive

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment
I flew AirAsia into here from Kuala Lumpar A friendly and efficient airport the connecting bus had me in Melbourne in about the same time as to Tullamarine as there was no jerking about

International Arrival at Tashkent is fine Bus from plane to terminal Very quick and smooth passport control no landing card needed no forms to fill in Baggage Reclaim was slow for some reason Money Exchange in Baggage Reclaim Hall along with local mobile SIM Cards Baggage Xray and then walk in fenced off compound to where taxis and buses await the usual scrum of offers of taxi etc Domestic Departures in separate building which is older Xray and show ticketETicket to get in then Checkin desks Security scanning of hand luggage basic water is allowed to go through Departure Hall has gates for bus loading of planes There is a small cafe serving drinkssnacks and seats International Departures is in a separate building scanned to get in and lots of Checkin Desks Only Money Exchange that was reluctant to exchange Uzbek Soms but did so very important as there is nowhere to do so after passport control Checkin show as no online checkin everyone has to checkin to get a Boarding Pass Passport Control quite quick and Security OK International Departures has a mix of shops selling local items and usual big brand alcholcigarettes price in USD or EUR prices OK A few cafes that were priced in local currency Euros or US Dollars Many departure screens and quite a lot of seating Only a couple of air bridges so most planes land on remote stands served by buses

Landed at Hangzhou Airport around using AirAsia X from Kuala Lumpur Immigration clearance was smooth and no hassle I claimed my luggage in just a few minutes Washroom services are as good as other airports in China The only lacking is the number of available seats on the departure floor at the checkin counters area

Was not impressed with food service and attitude Ordered glasses of wine at Mike Kitchen Charge AUS Is this reasonable Can get bottles for this price Was then told could not take wine into food court where we wanted to get something to eat Could not get food at Mikes Kitchen as kitchen was going to close in minutes Was not permitted to bring food from another outlet to have with my wine Shortly after wine was served was asked to hurry up as premises was about to close We were not advised hen purchasing wine that we would have to hurry up and drink Do not use Mikes Kitchen And then in a rush to buy food went to KFC where the very young staff had no interest in serving me and I was then told that most menu choices were unavailable and only zinger burgers were on sale My wife does not eat any spicy food Will avoid Sydney Airport on future visits to Australia or bring my own sandwiches and but wine in duty free Sadly spoilt an otherwise great visit to Australia

Awful airport On arrival was very smooth to be fair but the passport control queue was horrendous for those with UK passports and no accessibility and on departure despite wearing the sunflower lanyard and having booked fast track I was declined at fast track and made to queue for security and with my disabilities I struggle with long queuing The departure hall was very busy and hot with not many places to sit I had a great holiday in the Algarve but it was tarnished by the atrocity that is Faro Airport on a positive note however the toilets were very clean

Moscow to Bangkok Rossiya fly some of Aeroflots long haul flights with exEtihad Boeing s Their concept is strange They still have an old personal entertainment system but it only gives you a route map Really Instead they have an inflight wifisystem but to be able to use it you need to download Rossiya app before the flight wifi is only for the system its not connected to the WWW They do not have power sockets is economy class and remember your own headphones as well Our flight was on time No complains Food was ok nothing fancy They serve you two free meals with basic drinks no alcohol This will keep your belly full all flight Ive used many airlines and I have no complaints about Rossiya Ticket was cheap plane was comfy and clean flight was on time service was ok basic Russian style and they didnt lose our bags Good value Just remember what i told you about the entertainment system

Kazan to Baku Its not really a low cost airline because the cost is not low and quality is even lower than a usual lowcost But I had no choice Hand luggage is not included it is made clear on their website But the problem is that you cant pay for the hand luggage on their website you have to pay at checkin counter And they force you to pay in different currency using their crazy exchange rate so you will overpay for it a lot The reason as they explained it it is because they need to check your bag size and weight to see if it will fit Cant they allow to pay for it online and deal with overweight bags at the airport for extra cost My bag was within the limits but I had to pay more Surprisingly seats were pretty comfortable and spacious enough for tall people They even gave a free sandwich But teacoffee was not free Anyway I cant recommend to fly with Buta

Gatwick to Preveza return with Small Planet Airlines Our flights both ways could not have been any smoother and the experience was faultless I didnt try the food so unable to comment but all the staff were friendly and attentive Would use again

BRUJNBBRU with a stopover in Tripoli There were some troubles with the inflight entertainment On our way to JNB there were not enough headsets so we couldnt use the inflight entertainment On our way back from JNB to Tripoli the inflight entertainment in our part of the plane didnt work at all The food was okay and the cabin crew friendly Its definitely value for money but there are some things to improve

I flew one way from Melbourne to Canberra I paid extra for more leg room and extra for priority boarding It came to The flight left on time and arrived on time The seat was comfortable The staff were courteous Based on my experience I wouldnt hesitate to fly with this airline again

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

I tried to arrange a group trip with SyrianAir from London to Aleppo via Damascus and back Initially all was fine until they cancelled the first leg of the journey to Damascus a week prior to us leaving The next flight was days later but there was no immediate plane to Aleppo once we had arrived at Damascus which meant we would have to take a bus up instead a journey we werent too keen on While friendly the staff are fairly useless and I sat for MANY hours trying to sort things out We changed the flights to stay the same number of days but decided to go to Aleppo at the tail end of the trip under our own steam and the fly Allepo to London again via Damascus on the same ticket Unfortunately the staff didnt really get the group concept and kept issuing tickets for the wrong dates for different members of the group It took too many visits to their offices in Baker Street to finally get everyone on the same flights at the same time The flight to Syria was fine late and we managed to get up to Aleppo ourselves but the day before we were to fly out again we went into the Syrian air offices to confirm everything was ok IT WAS NOT They had cancelled the flight to Damascus without informing any of us and we had to arrange a midnight bus from Aleppo to Damascus Airport to make the correct flight back to London Luckily this one hadnt been cancelled But it was late My advice Dont Fly SyrianAir and if you do check on your flights constantly

The crew were extremely nice the flight was about hours and hours for the flight back to Hong Kong The flight was really smooth Props to the pilots The food was light and average The drinks were cool the in flight entertainment was out of service but pretty sure the airline is on a budget Warning that the ticket only includes kg of luggage to take on the plane and have to pay individually for luggage in cargo hold kg round trip more than HKD Seat was alright had decent recline trying to avoid flying with Hong Kong Airlines until maybe a few years later when they earn some money back Overall above average flight

Bangkok to Osaka Smooth check in and efficient seat allocation They didnt check cabin baggage weight nor size Had to buy food and drinks as refused internet preorder because we used a travel agent Seats ok but a night flight which was very uncomfortable Saw in the inflight magazine we could upgrade enroute to premium economy a good idea For B a good flight

This is a brand new terminal that opened just about nine months ago It is very well designed spacious light filled and comfortable with a limited yet sufficient number of traveler facilities Immigration both coming in and departing was quick and easy My only gripe is with the terminal and gate announcement system Every announcement in the airport even at the gate was totally garbled and not understandable There is something horribly wrong with the announcement system which really needs some immediate attention

Airport on Arrival no problem We hired a car and having found the car hire desk we were directed to the car pick up point which turned out to be a considerable distance away No shuttle service You just have to leg it If it had been raining we would have been soaked Cant imagine what it must be like for people in wheelchairs or families with pushchairs plus luggage Car hire needs to be closer to the terminal or shuttle service provided Departure was not good We had to leave our bags to be scanned go to the other side for Security check which meant leaving our bags and personal belongings unattended When called for our flight we were herded into a holding pen not enough seats stood for minutes while members of staff called out peoples names to re check their flight details this was done in a very unfriendly and unapologetic manner Took the shine off what had otherwise been a very pleasant trip to this beautiful island

Recently travelled with a broken ankle The staff were very helpful getting me on and off the plane The special waiting area was a nice touch because I was scared of getting knocked by other passengers

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

Kolkata to Colombo Average aircraft no IFE available Legroom is less but seat width is satisfactory Crew was quite active throughout the hour flight Announcements were clear and audible Restrooms were clean but only the rear restroom was allowed for the economy class passengers Boarding was smooth Food served was scanty but then it was a flight at am so no one was really hungry

Tashkent Airport has become very efficient on the international side Immigration and customs both on the way in and on departure were quite user friendly Not a lot of shops and restaurants but that was not inconvenient Readers should be aware that the domestic terminal is on the other side of the runway and it could take up to minutes to connect from one side to the other side using a taxi

Worst Airport in the world arrived to check in then security on baggage Then Passport machine thought great all good Walked through Duty Free then a mile long queue to get through to B gate BA is B gate Poor shops nobody could shop or eat unless you had got their hours early This queue apparently is normal and is called the new fast track what a joke One person in a box checking passports again Run to B hundreds of people standing there no way could you board in Groups just a free for all Again with one woman at the gate before you got on the coach to the plane still coaching you out to the plane She was checking everyones passport again Why havent they upgraded this system by now and built satellite gates off the main airport Not going back there

Paris Orly to PointePitre Overall good experience decent food friendly service on the inbound flight Outbound all of the crew disappeared at night difficult to get something to drink Some security concerns upon landing in Paris Crew didnt check the cabin at alltwo teens sleeping in lie flat position until touchdown No one to wake them up no one to remind them to put their seat in an upright position never saw that before Seats are ok but angled lie flat

Amsterdam to Heraklion Low cost budget airline in our case chartered by Neckermann Tickets were very cheap but the service not Good service departure on time friendly personnel Seating tight but thats the trade off for cheap tickets Airplane registered in Germany so safety and maintenance should be ok We had no issues whatsoever

I recently flew UL with family from MELCMBMEL return Given the many negative reviews seen here I was expecting a very poor product But to be honest I was pleasantly surprised Of course there is certainly room for improvement the seats could be more comfortable upholstery needs to be changed arms loose or broken needs an overall clean At times the quality of annoucements were not the best Boarding in CMB was a bit disorganised considering the flights were very full on both sectors But the IFE system for me and everyone around me was working in both sectors many reviewers here are complaining about it not working A decent selection of movies TV and music Good head sets Food was average airline food cant complain Cabin service was very professional helpful efficient and attentive Bagage was delivered to belt on time Checkin at both ends was OK Will definitely consider again I got what I paid for For those complaining please pay more and choose another airline

Old airport but reconstruction going on Very efficient immigration on the way in with separate lane for business class Fast delivery of luggage as well took me less than minutes to be out of the airport Departure wise a little bit slower but acceptable friendly immigration and security people very basic business lounge Departure procedure efficient despite lack of discipline of Chinese passengers always trying to jump queues

Comfortable and clean provincial airport Didnt use any facilities other than the toilets which were clean and tidy Only real criticism is lack of seats at the gates I was on a full A flight to Brisbane and there were only seats for about passengers There is also no segregation of incoming and outgoing passengers the former have to weave their way through those people waiting to board Passengers seated in the rear half of the cabin were requested to go down stairs across the tarmac then up stairs to the rear door of the aircraft However by the time I reached the front of the queue the outside doors had been locked so I had to fight my way through the whole length of the aircraft cabin

Getting into Kinshasa is quite OK getting out is something else The airlines dontcant have their own staff at the terminal all the flights Kenya South African Ethiopian are handled by the same slow and unfriendly personnel There is now an official exit tax of plus a couple of minor unofficial ones Airport is gloomy very little seating nothing to do except worry about what is going to happen next VIP exit lounge while hardly Heathrow is clean and bright and you get a free drink well worth the extra Even if you speak French dont even contemplate going to Kinshasa unless your hosthotel sends a protocol to meet you at the airport and escort you out Be sure to stock up with US bills for unofficial taxes they wont take less and they dont expect more On a more positive note it is irritating rather than frightening and once youre through the airport everybody is pleasant and everything is fine

I fly in and out of Philadelphia International Airport twice a week from Terminals B and C and I have nothing to complain about The layout is welldesigned making navigation easy and there are plenty of food and shopping options Security lines are usually efficient and the overall experience is smooth As a frequent traveler I know what bad airports look like and PHL is definitely not one of them Its a great airport that provides a convenient and pleasant journey every time

We flew EasyFly from Medellin EOH to Pereira When we checked in online we discovered theyd moved the flight minutes later This wasnt a problem for us and we checked in online without problem Check in at the airport was quick and we had no issues with bags one was slightly over kg one was under and we didnt get charged The flight was on time and upon arrival in PEI the bags were on the belt immediately The plane was clean and seemed fairly new It was impossible to buy a ticket from the US with a US credit card on their website however we were finally able to buy a ticket online using a Colombian travel agency Aviatur We had no problems and were pleased we chose EasyFly

Frequented CMB many times in the last decade and on the whole its ok It runs pretty smoothly and in fact has improved over the years the immigration particularly seems quicker I do however hate the exorbitant dollar priced fooddrink and duty free etc The contrast between what this cost just outside the door or the airport and the terminal prices must be one of the biggest contrasts in the world That said its a pretty painless experience to pass through

This is a very large and well maintained airport located in Virginia Given the size of this airport with its main terminal and then midfield terminals give yourself plenty of time to get to your gates especially the midfield terminals On arrival I had to take the mobile lounges to the main terminal The mobile lounges have frequent service from midfield terminal to main terminal No more than a min wait Restrooms in baggage claim are were very clean Departure was from Terminal C which necessitated using the labyrinth of escalators to get to the AeroTrains which run underground When I lived in Centreville VA Dulles was my airport of choice over Reagan National

Incheon Airport generally has a nice and clean layout making navigation straightforward However my experience today at Security Lane was quite disappointing Out of the three passport scanner machines only one was operational causing severe delays I joined the queue at PM and only cleared security at PM taking over hour and minutes to get through For an airport of this reputation such inefficiency was unexpected Thankfully I had arrived early for my PM flight or I might have missed it While the rest of the airport experience is great the management should urgently address such issues

The security staff at Aberdeen airport are not up to standard Many of them are aggressive and argumentative and their main aim is not to be friendly or courteous I have been fortunate enough to travel to many countries and I say without hesitation that the security staff at Aberdeen airport are either the most poorly trained that I have encountered or that they are paying no attention to the training they receive The management team needs to review the training of the security staff at Aberdeen airport urgently

Was not impressed with food service and attitude Ordered glasses of wine at Mike Kitchen Charge AUS Is this reasonable Can get bottles for this price Was then told could not take wine into food court where we wanted to get something to eat Could not get food at Mikes Kitchen as kitchen was going to close in minutes Was not permitted to bring food from another outlet to have with my wine Shortly after wine was served was asked to hurry up as premises was about to close We were not advised hen purchasing wine that we would have to hurry up and drink Do not use Mikes Kitchen And then in a rush to buy food went to KFC where the very young staff had no interest in serving me and I was then told that most menu choices were unavailable and only zinger burgers were on sale My wife does not eat any spicy food Will avoid Sydney Airport on future visits to Australia or bring my own sandwiches and but wine in duty free Sadly spoilt an otherwise great visit to Australia

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

I was subjected to a very intimate search three times by two different TSA agents The scanner was obviously malfunctioning How do I know Well I was clean but it kept saying I wasnt Then walking on the tarmac to the plane a baggage handler insisted that I had to valet my carryon bag Once inside seeing the mostly empty luggage bays I complained to the flight attendant She went and brought the bag to me with apologies Arrival was okay but the I had to follow a bread crumb trail of corridor stairs and turns all with inadequate signage Eventually I arrived at two luggage bays and was at first relieved to see my flight posted as unloading But it turned out that we did not get our luggage in hand for hr mins No information from the uncommunicative employee in the Baggage Office She said they were trying to find the agent to see if he has any more bags Im being generous here She told me to scan a lost baggage claim code which did not work
Friendly and fast service Enough toilets seats and bins But shops close early and have a extremely poor selection in duty free If you want anything make sure you get it before coming to the airport

I flew with my husband from Sharm El Sheikh to Cairo to see the pyramids and Egyptian Museum with a return flight to Sharm three days later The flight took off on time the cabin crew were friendly and the seats were comfortable Unfortunately my husband was taken ill in Cairo and I decided we needed to return to the UK I cancelled our return flight on the morning we were due to fly back to Sharm The money was in my bank two days later I would fly Air Cairo again

I have been travelling to the Gambia for six years now and have seen alot of changes at the airport over the years Security are very friendly people You can even sit out in the open and have a drink and a bite to eat and watch your plane land

A couple of weeks before my flight I got a sudden email that they had cancelled my flight and they rescheduled me to the earlier day which was not ok given my itinerary thankfully just an email sorted it out and they rebooked me on the day after my originally scheduled flight The ground staff were quite helpful and courteous but just before boarding the flight there was a crew member who refused to let me take my carryon into the flight and insisted that I check it in as well I tried explaining to her that my carryon had my laptop other electronics and my underwater camera equipment and was well within the weight and size limits specified and checked at the checkin counter but she was rude and insisted that I carry the stuff in my hand and leave the carryon to be checked in which was a shock but I had no choice but to comply and despite seeing me struggle I boarded the aircraft but thankfully a kind stewardess intervened and allowed me to bring the bag in The rest of the flight was quite smooth There was a snack service with some crackers and some juice being served The Dash is quite a comfortable aircraft in x configuration

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

This is a brand new terminal that opened just about nine months ago It is very well designed spacious light filled and comfortable with a limited yet sufficient number of traveler facilities Immigration both coming in and departing was quick and easy My only gripe is with the terminal and gate announcement system Every announcement in the airport even at the gate was totally garbled and not understandable There is something horribly wrong with the announcement system which really needs some immediate attention

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

New international terminal is ok but nothing special departure gates in total so not very big On arrival most people did VOA visa on arrival so queue to get it and then another queue to pay it took quite long On departure checkin and security went smoothly on airside there were only one shop and a caf open so there wasnt much to do Wifi is free but works onoff not good for streaming anything but good enough for basic surfing At least terminal is new and clean with decent air conditioning

I usually fly budget so dont expect too much Had my first flight with Mihin Lanka from Chennai to Colombo Plane was not new but Im glad the flight was only hour as the seats felt like they had lost all their padding The flight went smoothly except the Stewards did not offer any option to purchase refreshments It may seem unnecessary on a short flight except by the time you have got to the airport and followed all procedures a few hours have ticked over and some refreshments would come in handy Probably what concerned me most was the fellow passenger pouring a hot drink from his flask to his wife How did that get through security There was someone on his mobile phone as we were landing The other fellow who grabbed his luggage and made his way to the front door before the plane had stopped

I specifically chose to fly with TransNusa to try out flying on the COMAC ARJ of which the carrier currently operates two of these aircraft at the moment and is also the first airline in the world outside of China to operate this small commercial jetliner Thankfully there wasnt much of a negative experience everything from checkin to boarding to the inflight experience was prompt and precise even if it werent spectacular As TransNusa opts for a singleclass layout the aircraft has a capacity of passengers seated in rows of The smaller capacity of the aircraft meant that boarding and disembarkation was completed fairly quickly and smoothly Arguably the only sore point of the flight was having to use a bus to board the aircraft instead of using an aerobridge TransNusa includes kg of checked bags as part of the basic air ticket so thats a nice gesture to have Despite having to land in heavy rain at KLIA the entire journey was uneventful and decently pleasant and it suggests that the COMAC ARJ will prove a contender in the regional small commercial jetliner market in the years to come

HKGBKK I booked with them because it was the only airline available Check in took hr in HKG and plane was a year old B Entertainment was pretty much nothing and seats were the most uncomfortable Ive ever experienced Plane and bathroom were unclean I booked a seat in the upper deck and it was quiet Food was horrible Only good thing was the value because I you pretty much get everything for that cheap price

Arriving in Manado from Singapore by SilkAir is always a good experience The greenery around the airport was beautiful and the short walk less than minutes from the plane to the immigration counter is a relief compared to the minute walk I used to have in Changi when rushing from immigration to the gate The terminal building is quite clean and adequate The only downside is the crowd outside the arriving gate exit There were lots of illegal taxis touting arriving passengers The lack of seating area outside the terminal is also a concern as it was hard to find a proper place to sit while waiting for someone to arrive

Decided to fly this route to mainland China instead of my usual HKG Flew from TSAKNH return on what seemed to be a new Embraer E This airline is the domestic offshoot for China Airlines and the English language version of their website is a simple cut and paste from the international airline However the baggage allowance for domestic Taiwanese flights is only KG so I had to really point out that the English information states KG and after some trouble I was able to fly without having to pay extra Despite that the actual flight to and from Kinmen was quick comfortable and care free Only a snack and water was served on the flight but it was only minutes long so it was not an issue I was pleased to have been given the Emergency Exit row on both flights too handy being the taller westerner that I am Except for the baggage allowance issue I can not find fault with them

On the understanding that Srinagar being the capital of Indian administered Kashmir is at the centre of one of longest running conflicts in the world then one should expect a particularly unique experience regarding airport security Srinagar airport in this respect does not disappoint On arrival on Jet Airways from Delhi one is immediately struck by the fact that this is a military airfield masquerading as a civilian airport MiG fighters and helicopter gunships abound at the far end of the airfield and all buildings are camoflauge painted The odd civilian Boening looks incongruous For arriving foreigners you are accosted by a security official fairly politely it must be said to fill in a long registration document He then accompanies you out of the arrival and baggage collection hall on a dirt track to the carpark to ensure you are being met by whoever you had claimed you were on the form Only then can you be on your way If you are not being met I am not sure what your fate would be Departure though is an object lesson in airport security The first hurdle is a kilometer or so before the airport terminal where you are stopped at a roadblock and put your luggage through an xray machine Entering the airport and only passengers are allowed not guests or friends you again put bags through another xray sceeening Then you are allowed to go to check in after which you must as a foreigner fill out another lengthy departure registration form for the police No hand luggage whatsoever is allowed on Delhi bound flights so all you can carry is what you can fit in your pockets therefore travel with a multipocket vest or similar to maximise carry on potential Hand carried clear plastic water bottles do suprisingly seem OK though to carry on The waiting area after check in is basic but OK as long as you dont mind being stared at suspiciously by numerous armed army and poice men Then there is another long queue for a more detailed security check which involves turning out all pockets and being individually scanned Finally you are through to the actual departure area but this is not the end After being released to go out on foot to your waiting Boeing you again go through another security check all pockets and a patdown before eventually you board the plane Great views of the Himalayas to the north on the flight out but since cameras are not allowed on board the memories stay in your mind and not on film

This June we booked on La Compangnie Newark to Paris return Our flight over was cancelled hours before departure We had firm bookings on a flight Paris to London La Compagnie offered us a later flight instead of Paris to Nice Of course we could not make our Paris to London connection We dropped that and waited until the next morning flying directly to London from Nice We incurred an extra nights stay in Nice taxi rides a lost ticket from Paris to London lost return flight when you dont show for the first flight you lose the return and a lost night in our London hotel adding up to over a thousand dollars in extra costs At the end of our stay in England and Paris we were told that our flight from Paris to Newark was also cancelled If we arrived at am at Orly we would be put on the morning flight instead of the more comfortable afternoon departure Flights for people both cancelled and we are repeat customers The check in people at La Compangie said the company would meet us they did not would reimburse us if we showed receipts they did not After multiple attempts to contact anyone by phone and waiting for weeks they more or less told us too bad we owe you nothing Unless you are willing to see your flight changed with very little notice and you have a great deal of flexibility or insurance at the other end do not fly this amateur operation

Considering the standard for Brazilian Airports the Capitals is very modern Good options for shopping and eating and even some cinema theaters As it is one of the hubs of the country the traffic in intense most of the time There is a lack of good transportation options for the city There is no subway station the buses are rare and uncomfortable and the taxis are quite expensive

Siem Reap to Da Nang I purchased a flight without baggage I purchased baggage separately for AU with great difficulty via the Cambodia Angkor Air website I received the receipt on Messenger The receipt could not be located at Siem Reap airport I was forced to then pay US to get my luggage on board I have emailed the airline with the receipt and transcript but there has been no response On board I had never seen a refreshment trolley pushed along the aisle with such speed allowing nobody the opportunity to obtain a drink

Orlando to Jackson I am a frequent traveler and have flown my entire life My mother is a Delta flight attendant of years and when I was young she would take me on her flights I had flown over times before the age of Given this background I am very particular when it comes to my air travel Going into flying with Via I had my reservations as I normally stick to the main carriers but their service and in flight experience greatly exceeded both me and my fiancs expectations Would gladly fly with Via Air again and look forward to the next chance I get to fly with them

Pasco Kennewick in Washington State is a small efficient airport currently under rebuild On arrival my bags were delivered quickly and it was a short but slightly circuitous route to landslide longer because of rebuilding work On departure checkin was quick TSA was both quick and helpful and the gate area reasonably spacious There is a cafe in the gate area and the walk to the plane is very short The one downside of the gate area is that there is loud musak playing over the tannoy presumably to entertain us at the same time as the gate announcements hence you have no idea what the gate announcement is saying Car parking is free for the first minutes The free wifi was too slow for use there is a premium version for a fee

I agree entirely with Fernando Immigration staff also very helpful as well as friendly and efficient Only problem now is the collapsed bridge on the road to Caracas A diversion has been made but is only two lanes and is operated on a tidal system Can add an hour or two to the journey

UIOCCS There were no problems to speak of nor was the experience extraordinarily positive First off I should say that I had problems in booking via the Santa Barbara website and so had to visit their agency in Quito I had my bags fairly thoroughly checked by migration people in Quito but thats understandable given the flow of drugs in the region The flight itself was fine Boeing no obvious neglect crew were friendly enough food was decent We did leave about mins late At the Caracas end our bags were slow in arriving It seems that there are problems but you may get lucky and avoid them as I did

Used T this time for both departure and arrival I fancy this strange facility with flavor of s after its recent refurbishment Overall clean and well looked after with all lifts and escalators and travelators working with meaningful food options bearable security queues and convenient transportation access via bus and monorail it does the job and does not irritate Well done

HarareLondonHarare Originally booked flight on Friday which was cancelled Flights were punctual and staff friendly Old planes and no entertainment But being the only direct flight to Europe from Harare and with prices less then half of any other airline still OK for anybody wanting a cheap flight to London as long as one has the flexibility to cope with changes of schedule

I flew with my husband from Sharm El Sheikh to Cairo to see the pyramids and Egyptian Museum with a return flight to Sharm three days later The flight took off on time the cabin crew were friendly and the seats were comfortable Unfortunately my husband was taken ill in Cairo and I decided we needed to return to the UK I cancelled our return flight on the morning we were due to fly back to Sharm The money was in my bank two days later I would fly Air Cairo again

Bagan to Heho Very short flight again another ATR aircraft as a nervous passenger I was not looking forward to the flight but it was great Seating was no seat numbers given as only a few passengers on this flight No Inflight snack but coffee or cold drinks were supplied All in all a good flight and would travel again

We flew EasyFly from Medellin EOH to Pereira When we checked in online we discovered theyd moved the flight minutes later This wasnt a problem for us and we checked in online without problem Check in at the airport was quick and we had no issues with bags one was slightly over kg one was under and we didnt get charged The flight was on time and upon arrival in PEI the bags were on the belt immediately The plane was clean and seemed fairly new It was impossible to buy a ticket from the US with a US credit card on their website however we were finally able to buy a ticket online using a Colombian travel agency Aviatur We had no problems and were pleased we chose EasyFly

I was surprised when I arrived at Berlin Tempelhof how small the airport was However the facilities are there although in a small scale and the airport is relatively clean and friendly Not a bad airport just a bit out of date

What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal
Comfortable enough flight which was fairly on time We were surprised that there was no catering on this flight of about hours Only took hand baggage

Seoul to Busan First time with Air Busan and it was great Price App check in employees serviceluggage and on time At the check in I was offered an earlier flight no fee There were no problems with this airline and trip Recommend

Busy and crowded on both Sundays However queues were manageable Inbound immigration went smoothly Baggage hall is still a scrum but more staff on duty to assist Check in was quick and efficient Food and drink are overpriced Sufficient seating in boarding area

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

Excellent security Left my laptops by mistake at security and went to my plane I noticed once in the plane While I couldnt deboard the staff and pilot called security and they were found and brought to lost and found A friend picked them up days later

This review is limited to Terminal This terminal is very convenient as all of Southwests gates are in one location which means connection times of minutes is more than enough to catch connecting flight As I had a very short layover I did not access WiFi The terminal was crowded midmorning but theres plenty of seating The bathrooms are very clean

A small airport serving the Transylvania town of Sibiu Its a walk boarding only one constructed new in an off the shelf design barebone Operation is fast and efficient staff is a bit reserved but friendly and professional Romania is now a Schengen country so no more border control to most EU flights Airside theres one food and beverages shop and one dutyfree Both are nothing to rave about There are taxis to the city and a modern bus which is cheaper

Tular to Antananarivo Quick Checkin on time plane a bit old refreshments and a snack served friendly flight attendants The fare was somehow high but this is Madagascar You shouldnt come here if you are pampered by lowcost carriers

I was surprised when I arrived at Berlin Tempelhof how small the airport was However the facilities are there although in a small scale and the airport is relatively clean and friendly Not a bad airport just a bit out of date

Decided to fly this route to mainland China instead of my usual HKG Flew from TSAKNH return on what seemed to be a new Embraer E This airline is the domestic offshoot for China Airlines and the English language version of their website is a simple cut and paste from the international airline However the baggage allowance for domestic Taiwanese flights is only KG so I had to really point out that the English information states KG and after some trouble I was able to fly without having to pay extra Despite that the actual flight to and from Kinmen was quick comfortable and care free Only a snack and water was served on the flight but it was only minutes long so it was not an issue I was pleased to have been given the Emergency Exit row on both flights too handy being the taller westerner that I am Except for the baggage allowance issue I can not find fault with them

There are two options for getting from Dar es Salaam to Zanzibar a twohour ferry journey or a minute flight The main airlines flying this route are Auric Air and Air Tanzania Ordering the ticket via Opodo was easy and the airline operates from Terminal a small building about km from the main terminals Checkin was efficient and the waiting room had several powerful air conditioning units You could even buy food and drink Tickets were checked and we were walked across to the Cessna It had three seats in each row and although tight it was not uncomfortable It only had a pilot and we flew at about feet giving us a clear view of the sea and then the island It ended with a very smooth landing close to the terminal

Our arrival was great No problems The airport was clean People were friendly Renting a car was a bit of a pain because it was in another building a long way to drag several bags When departing we arrived hours early but had to wait about minutes before checking our bags There were only people working one for frequent flyers and one for the rest of us The couple at the head of our line had a problem and it took minutes for the lady to get the problem worked out When we got in line there were people in line By the time we were being checked in there were people in line Again everything was clean and the people were very pleasant

I fly in and out of Philadelphia International Airport twice a week from Terminals B and C and I have nothing to complain about The layout is welldesigned making navigation easy and there are plenty of food and shopping options Security lines are usually efficient and the overall experience is smooth As a frequent traveler I know what bad airports look like and PHL is definitely not one of them Its a great airport that provides a convenient and pleasant journey every time

International Arrival at Tashkent is fine Bus from plane to terminal Very quick and smooth passport control no landing card needed no forms to fill in Baggage Reclaim was slow for some reason Money Exchange in Baggage Reclaim Hall along with local mobile SIM Cards Baggage Xray and then walk in fenced off compound to where taxis and buses await the usual scrum of offers of taxi etc Domestic Departures in separate building which is older Xray and show ticketETicket to get in then Checkin desks Security scanning of hand luggage basic water is allowed to go through Departure Hall has gates for bus loading of planes There is a small cafe serving drinkssnacks and seats International Departures is in a separate building scanned to get in and lots of Checkin Desks Only Money Exchange that was reluctant to exchange Uzbek Soms but did so very important as there is nowhere to do so after passport control Checkin show as no online checkin everyone has to checkin to get a Boarding Pass Passport Control quite quick and Security OK International Departures has a mix of shops selling local items and usual big brand alcholcigarettes price in USD or EUR prices OK A few cafes that were priced in local currency Euros or US Dollars Many departure screens and quite a lot of seating Only a couple of air bridges so most planes land on remote stands served by buses

Amsterdam to Heraklion Low cost budget airline in our case chartered by Neckermann Tickets were very cheap but the service not Good service departure on time friendly personnel Seating tight but thats the trade off for cheap tickets Airplane registered in Germany so safety and maintenance should be ok We had no issues whatsoever
TPEKHH one way Plane full but staff friendly on time and no complaints A bargain considering the onehour flight was only about USD

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

I recently flew out of Manchester Terminal A great experience from leaving the car at the pre booked car park No queues at bag drop off or security even though I had bought a fast track pass The terminal is clean bright and well appointed Within minutes of arrival I was eating breakfast in San Carlo My return trip was as efficient within one hour of landing I had collected my car and was at home Terminal is a revelation after the dire experiences of Terminal Well done from me

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

Kazan to Baku Its not really a low cost airline because the cost is not low and quality is even lower than a usual lowcost But I had no choice Hand luggage is not included it is made clear on their website But the problem is that you cant pay for the hand luggage on their website you have to pay at checkin counter And they force you to pay in different currency using their crazy exchange rate so you will overpay for it a lot The reason as they explained it it is because they need to check your bag size and weight to see if it will fit Cant they allow to pay for it online and deal with overweight bags at the airport for extra cost My bag was within the limits but I had to pay more Surprisingly seats were pretty comfortable and spacious enough for tall people They even gave a free sandwich But teacoffee was not free Anyway I cant recommend to fly with Buta
My budget airline fare turned out to be a complete surprise with full service and a fairly new A plane The service friendliness and cleanliness are no less than those of Singapore Airlines

The airport is much better than before after the construction of the new terminal and the renovation of the old one Much cleaner more shops better signage etc However the passenger experience is affected by the lack of jet bridges and the use of buses for going to and from the aircraft The buses are hot in the summer and cold in winter and they are probably unsafe during the pandemic If jet bridges cannot be added then passengers should be allowed to walk to and from the aircraft with buses used only during poor weather The external spaces also need some greening up and better maintenance

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you
Newquay airport is excellent apart from the abysmal state of seating in the main departure lounge Seating all torn and very scruffy It has been like this for a long time Unacceptable

Kuala Namu International Airport is it is the second largest airport after SoekarnoHatta International Airport but the first airport which has a direct rail link to Medan city the capital of North Sumatra Kuala Namu is the most comfortable and the most modern airport in Indonesia

Busy and crowded on both Sundays However queues were manageable Inbound immigration went smoothly Baggage hall is still a scrum but more staff on duty to assist Check in was quick and efficient Food and drink are overpriced Sufficient seating in boarding area

TokyoOsakaTokyo Starflyer has the best costperformance ratio of the market very comfortable leather seat in A Easy to get emergency exit at check in when requested but still at least inch legroom Drink service PTV footrest for hour flight and professional attendants At a unbeatable rate when booking a bit in advance even less than the Shinkansen The only drawbacks are the lack of frequency for Osaka comparing to JL or NH still OK with flights per day
Madrid to Toulouse Once again a punctual and comfortable flight Good legroom on time departure and arrival On flight entertainment was however not working you have to pay for anything on board

This airport is so backward its unreal Today you get charged nearly three euros to get hot water for your own teabag You get charged ten euros development fee as you leave Same as Galway airport ten years ago six euros to get out again development fee now its shut Last time I flew from Knock the fee was the same Never went back because of the fee Now the place has hardly changed where did that money go Great idea to put an airport on top of a hill dont have to come down so far but hardly a great advert for Irish aviation or Mayo

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

Security was good because you didnt have to get liquids or electronics out of your bag Airport was clean and spacious My one huge complaint however is the service in Autogrill Italia The staff member asked me if I would like to pay times without putting it through to the card machine She would just point at it and then say PAY There was a language barrier but I feel there may have been an intelligence barrier because I stood there for mins wanting to pay and not being able to

Vnukovo Airport Waiting for baggage almost hour now and havent get it yet No extra infornation from airport officials In combination with absence of smoking rooms everything becomes socalled great Ill consider another airport the next time Though ceiling is ok

A very small airport ours was the only plane there when we landed so visa immigration and luggage was quick though I doubt if they could manage with more than one plane at once Departure check in quick and efficient The airport is clean with a number of duty free shops bit tacky

Needs a proper restaurant Toilets are not up to the hygiene standard and are very congested I am muslim and offer regular prayers but call is very loud need to maintain at comfortable listening Needs further variety of fast food international chains to have a quick meal

The airport is clean very functional and not too big to the point it becomes customer unfriendly As expected most products available to buy are well overpriced Passport control and security was a breeze

Overall our experience my wife and myself in transit twice in KGL has been satisfactory certainly compared with airports in the region with regard to seating not very comfortable but OK cleanliness including toilets signage and announcements attitude of official personnel security and boarding procedures Free WIFI did not work However we have been ripped off when purchasing goods from the VIVA GLOBAL DUTY FREE SHOP billed much higher prices than advertised no receipt received for some goods which we also paid far too much in USD We did not have our luggage on arrival at destination travel with Rwandair to BRU our suitcases arrived early next day via another company but we had to collect them from the airport since Rwandair does not have a policy of sending delayed luggage to the home

We used Luxor airport both for internal flight to Cairo and international flight to UK On both occasions it was clean and airy with plenty of space to sit We were allowed to take our water with us so no problem in buying drinks Yes there was someone selling us toilet paper despite the notices saying this was not allowed but by then we knew their standard of living and if you cant spare the odd pound when we have spent so much on a holiday what does that say about us We were protected from harassment by helpers by our rep Altogether I thought using Luxor airport a pleasant experience

We booked a day trip to Luxor from Sharm and flew Air Memphis Aircraft was an old MD which was tired looking inside and out but clean Friendly cabin crew juice and a snack were served Dont let appearances put you off

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though

Tular to Antananarivo Quick Checkin on time plane a bit old refreshments and a snack served friendly flight attendants The fare was somehow high but this is Madagascar You shouldnt come here if you are pampered by lowcost carriers

I agree entirely with Fernando Immigration staff also very helpful as well as friendly and efficient Only problem now is the collapsed bridge on the road to Caracas A diversion has been made but is only two lanes and is operated on a tidal system Can add an hour or two to the journey

Cusco Airport is another wonderfully crowded and poorly designed airfield in Peru ie Lima Chiclayo Byzantine brutalist concrete architecture aside this airport is by far the worst designed for providing any kind of logical flow for a singlerunway airport serving a large metropolitan area It would seem that nobody in government has looked at what can be done with the cramped space and volume of passengers to try and make a more hospitable clean and userfriendly facility Unfortunately this airport will remain the sole thoroughfare for all international Machu Picchu travelers for the foreseeable future Maybe Peru can step up to the plate and make some major changes to this facility and take a field trip to Quito and check out their new airport which is very nice

We booked a day trip to Luxor from Sharm and flew Air Memphis Aircraft was an old MD which was tired looking inside and out but clean Friendly cabin crew juice and a snack were served Dont let appearances put you off

Its been years since I traveled through Terminal The refurbished Terminal is a world class modern airport terminal It is spacious brightly lit with plenty of seating and dining options aplenty There are oodles of power ports and USB ports at the gates however some of the power ports were not working Bathrooms are very clean The concourses are wide and directions easy to follow to baggage claim Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished terminal is a significant upgrade to the old terminal

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates

Minsk Airport was recently renovated and even though the layout may be outdated it looks brand new The airport is easy to get around and there are plenty of signs and directions for the passengers I did not experience any queues at all neither at checkin nor with the security and passport control it was all very quick and professional The terminal is extremely clean just like the city is which is almost surreal at times given that it is the place where thousands of people pass through every single day Food and shopping options seem standard for the airport of this size there is a dutyfree shop a souvenir shop fast food restaurant and a few cafeterias The only problem is that I havent seen any money exchange offices Airport staff are very professional and efficient When it comes to wifi there is a minute free connection however one can buy a very cheap wifi service for several days which also works in the city The main downside of the airport is the fact that it is so far away from the city and that there are no low cost options
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Not bad

I flew from Blackpool airport to Belfast for the first time I always fly from Liverpool to Belfast with Easyjet but the flight times were better and it was slightly cheaper to fly with Jet from Blackpool I was expecting a small airport with limited facilities but nothing prepared me for the facilities here Parking is free which was a bonus for me when booking on arrival however both car parks P and P were full and ended up abandoning my car on a grass area known as an overfill car park This was a minute walk to the airport On arrival there was nothing before the departure lounge The cash machine was out of service and WHSmiths closed Paying the airport charge was no problem and I was assisted with my baggage tag by a very helpful Jet worker The worst experience was going through security where the staff were extremely rude not just with me but with an elderly couple in front of me I agree that security needs to be strict but not intrusive and this was made a much more uncomfortable experience by the rudeness and lack of customer service with the staff I will never be using this airport again and even after a drink from the limited choice in the cafebar I was still reeling I can safely say this is the st and last time I will use this airport

Seoul to Busan First time with Air Busan and it was great Price App check in employees serviceluggage and on time At the check in I was offered an earlier flight no fee There were no problems with this airline and trip Recommend

Domestic terminal is easy to use not much going on and no crowds or wait times It has sufficient seating capabilities but restaurant and shopping options are fairly limited But it serves its purpose is reasonably clean and convenient

Flew Star Peru from Lima to Cusco Pleasantly surprised after reading dire reviews here Departure was more or less on time in small rather old plane It was mostly empty too Seats not incredibly comfortable but very short flight anyway Price not a bargain but not terribly expensive no point booking in advance BTW as fares do not seem to really vary that much Flight was fine and service was rather good and polite onboard with snacks drink and luggage all included in fare No issues at all

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE

A good experience overall with Eastar Jet flying from Jeju to Gimpo The flight was cheap and easy to book on the airlines website I was sent an email a couple of days before flying Pity it was only in Korean I assumed it to be a routine one that airlines commonly send and assume I was correct as there were no repercussions Baggage is a stingy kg why and mine was I was charged for one extra kilo which seems like taking rules to extremes Everything else was satisfactory Checkin was quick the flight was more or less on time and reasonably comfortable and baggage reclaim quick

PSP is a great little airport The s style terminal is fairly well designed but with the advent of security screening areas its a bit harder to negotiate Rental cars are right outside the door from the baggage carousels The weather is seldom a problem so flights stay pretty close to their schedules Parking is reasonably priced and convenient to the terminal

It was my first time flying with PLAY and I have no complaints whatsoever I booked a roundtrip flight from Hamilton CA to Berlin Germany for US PLAY Flex with seat choice in the front of the plane and one kilo piece of checked luggage included What more can you ask for at this price The crews were friendly the seats have plenty of leg room the plane was clean There are no screens free movies etc and you have to pay for drinks ie Euros for a cup of coffee thats less than at the airport I was happy to pay for my coffee and to read a book instead of watching a movie because I saved about compared to a flight on a US airline out of Buffalo NY where I live To all those writing bad reviews regarding carryon luggage Ive seen people carrying large duffle bags onto the plane or a rather large suitcase a backpack AND a stuffed shopping bag type of bag and the crews were very helpful finding room for those bags in the cabin What are these people complaining about My personal opinion Pay a little more when making your reservation check your luggage and quit complaining I dont understand the I have to take my entire household into the cabin mentality at all And remember if there are issues at the airport with carryon luggage or a long wait for your checked luggage its not on the airline its on the airport employees And that is the only complaint I have the check in people at BER are very unfriendly But those are Swissport employees not PLAY employees Thank you PLAY for a very nice experience

Tbilisi to Baku Everything went smoothly here Boarding was quick and on time We were pushed back on time which also meant the flight left on time It was only a short hop of mins I will see how they are again when I fly hours plus on my next flight Overall No issues Airline very smooth and would recommend

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

Recently travelled with a broken ankle The staff were very helpful getting me on and off the plane The special waiting area was a nice touch because I was scared of getting knocked by other passengers

I read a huge amount of negativity about this airport prior to my trip there it was a five hour transit stop going from London to Bangkok I was certainly concerned reading all the previous reviews However I didnt experience any real issues The airport is very large so easy to find a quiet spot there are plenty of power outlets and getting online is extremely simple you just log on and take a pic of your passport Granted you wont be able to do very much online unless youve got one of the VPNs that work behind the great China firewall but if you have an iPad with a couple of movies downloaded the time will soon pass There was a reasonable amount of shops open both for coffee and souvenir shopping The train that youll need to take to get to your gate is frequent clean and fast Overall Ive been to more interesting airports but my message would be dont stress out reading the negative reviews I had no issues whatsoever

This June we booked on La Compangnie Newark to Paris return Our flight over was cancelled hours before departure We had firm bookings on a flight Paris to London La Compagnie offered us a later flight instead of Paris to Nice Of course we could not make our Paris to London connection We dropped that and waited until the next morning flying directly to London from Nice We incurred an extra nights stay in Nice taxi rides a lost ticket from Paris to London lost return flight when you dont show for the first flight you lose the return and a lost night in our London hotel adding up to over a thousand dollars in extra costs At the end of our stay in England and Paris we were told that our flight from Paris to Newark was also cancelled If we arrived at am at Orly we would be put on the morning flight instead of the more comfortable afternoon departure Flights for people both cancelled and we are repeat customers The check in people at La Compangie said the company would meet us they did not would reimburse us if we showed receipts they did not After multiple attempts to contact anyone by phone and waiting for weeks they more or less told us too bad we owe you nothing Unless you are willing to see your flight changed with very little notice and you have a great deal of flexibility or insurance at the other end do not fly this amateur operation

Tiny but well kept airport different design not too many flights but departure lounge seemed chaotic Immigration is friendly but takes a long time a few shops you need to pay attention to the counters to find out where youre going to checkin Overall experience fair
