Id read the many bad reviews about Frankfurt Airport and approached our transit through there with some trepidation Well we flew from Manchester and landed on time A bus quickly took us to Arrivals and we made our way to Terminal Z This is supposed to be a major hub for international travel but I was completely underwhelmed After being directed through the inevitable duty free youre decanted into a very long wide corridor with gates on the left and right all of the way along On the plus side the wifi worked the toilets were clean and there was at least water fountain On the minus side it was very crowded and the refreshments available I found were at a Bakery a small shop selling drinks and sandwiches and some handcarts selling hotdogs pretzels etc Very poor We had a hour wait until our flight to Dubai and it dragged and dragged Boarding acomplete shambles There were airport staff at the gate and only one of them was dealing with boarding I felt like taking over and getting them organised Very glad when we eventually took off

We were flying to Larnaca from Prague and had a connecting flight through Dusseldorf We arrived on time everything was OK as we didnt expect anything negative First surprise was that in order to pass the passport control you needed to take the stairs and no elevator available nearby so we had to carry our bags The passport control was OK and then we had to take bother stairs down but we kind of got used already to the comfort provided by the airport Finally we found our gate and decided to get some snack The only tiny little counter with brezels and only sparkling water was not working The coffee machine was out of order too There was a notice that the next snack stand was nearby by it was not true in this area around gates A and it was the only one There was also a machine that was supposed to be selling drinks but it was out of order as well I would not be surprised if the lavatory would be unavailable as well So we spent nice hours waiting for our connecting flight and I will make sure not to get tickets through this airport anymore Weve never experienced anything like this before I would be glad to read some positive review about this airport one day But I doubt it could happen

Beyond belief I hope this was just an unfortunate twooff experience as we had a lovely holiday in all respects with the exception of arrival and departure at Bourgas Airport Arrival am massive queues extending to the outside of terminal building waiting for staff to open up Passport Control Queued for minutes after which staff yes only came on duty to process us through by which time other arriving flights had joined the queue On eventually reaching the manned booth attitude of staff member was most unpleasant Departure arrived at airport am and again massive queues accumulated for Desks Situation was not helped by incorrect desk checkin information being displayed for other flights to join our queue Queued for minutes outside in hot sun then another minutes inside a stuffy unairconditioned area Security all I can say is that I have never encountered such arrogance and rudeness Please dont think this is typical of Bulgaria as it is not Hotel staff and locals were all very hospitable and I would like to return but do hope that airport staff are given a much needed customer relations course I know we Brits are renowned for our orderly queues but there is a limit to our patience and if they want to encourage tourism to their country get they need to get their act together

Very early flight AM Was booked to allow an immediate connection with MADGIG on Iberia Business class too However the second leg was cancelled by Iberia months ago and they booked us to Rio de Janeiro on the following day Very unfairly they refused to also move the MRSMAD leg petty atitude on Iberia side is it really worth paying a Business Class Therefore we had to spend a night in Madrid at our expenses

Trinidad to Barbados I was planning a long weekend with friends in Trinidad I live mostly in Barbados but also in London UK Id been umming and aahhing between LIAT and Caribbean Airlines and I checked out the reviews for LIAT which are definitely not good I regularly fly between Barbados and Jamaica via Caribbean Airlines which involves a stoptransit through Trinidad and my transit experiences have not been good Delays cancellations etc One time arriving in Barbados at around am instead of the scheduled m and anyone who knows Piarco airport would agree that it has to be the most soulless airport ever no information is given few places to eat get a coffee etc Piarco departure lounge is BRUTAL In the end I decided on Caribbean Airlines for my outward bound flight and LIAT for my return I rationalised that if the CA flight due to depart at around was late I could spend hours there whereas if I took the afternoon LIAT fight even with cancellations that I stood a reasonably good chance of arriving in Barbados before midnight As it happens luck seemed to have been on my side LIAT reviews are full of tales of delays cancellations rude staff wtc Im happy to say that this was not my experience The flight departed minutes later than its scheduled pm time slot which in aviationairline term is not at all late and got me into Barbados within the hour All staff were pleasant and helpful as needed We were served a beverage which CA did not offer on the outward bound journey Flight was pleasant seats were reasonably comfortable pilotcaptain kept us informed and I really liked their inflight magazine Overall I was very pleasantly surprised because as I said LIAT has very poor reviews and everyone that I had consulted prior to booking had warned me off LIAT As I say I may just have been very fortunate but for this flight at least everything went well and if LIAT could maintain this standard I would happily fly LIAT again even though Im a confirmed CA fan

Helsinki to Moscow Nordic Regional Airlines operated flight on behalf of Finnair Not a great start as it was delayed mins The crew was clearly tired just barely kept their eyes open Plane about years old Embraer Dirty seat covers yuck Service was Finnairs basic low budget concept Free coffee or tea or blueberry juice Of course snacks are available if you like to use extra money I bought a long drink for euros With the help of a strong tailwind our flight almost caught up the delayed time Flight time today only hr mins Everything was ok although i didnt really like the sleepy crew

Booked seats one way from Phnom Penh to Siem Reap on the Bassaka Air web site which only seem to be released month in advance FAs were very attentive in helping store luggage reasonable English spoken Cabin announcements were clear seat comfort was okay The flight is only minutes with take off and landing but they still were able to serve given either juice or water On time flight I would fly with Bassaka Air again good price ticket US with taxes

Kuala Lumpur to Hong Kong the first leg of a trip to IAD Checkin at KLIA was very efficient and the checkin staff were very helpful The boarding process was handled well with CX staff on hand making clear announcements The plane was old and tired and the tray table was dirty stained with spilled food and orange juice On board the FAs were pleasant and efficient but thats where it ended There was no personal interaction of any sort They did their jobs well and efficiently but thats it The food was disappointing small portions and not great in flavour The IFE was good with an extensive choice of programs Generally an unremarkable experience but we did leave on time

Visiting the island for the first time I was impressed on how modern and functional the airport was First they send you to the Egates which does not make sense as you will line up again for them to check the airport tax The officer will ask you how long are you going to stay and stamp you in if you do not have bags youre outside the airport in seconds Taxis will ask you euros if you have time and a tight budget outside on the main highway there is a bus stop but do not count on when a bus will show up it depends on your luck On the way out the lines move quick security is also quick immigration will snap your photo again and stamp you out The sole complaint is about the annoucements volume it is ridiculous Overall Sal island is to be visited once in a lifetime I would say

Nadi is a fine airport in some ways and an airport in need of even more significant improvements in other ways After flying in and out twice Im glad to see this small airport mostly modernized at least the lobby and checkin areas and looking very beautiful This is a reflection of the success of Fijis tourism industry and the welcoming face that Fiji wants to portray for tourists Checkin was not a challenge at all Going through customs and immigration leaving the airport briefly then going back through security pregate were no problem The signage to shuttle buses taxis and public buses could still stand to be improved but the airport was so small that I found where I was going A bus pass can be bought for Fijian dollars and a bus can be taken into central Nadi for less than USD Connecting to your next flight should be no issue as like I said going through customs is no problem as long as you dont have anything significant to declare Now there are some cons First of all theres only one gift shop thingy I can remember postsecurity and their prices are as high or higher on some products than youd pay in the USA Australia or New Zealand They have a monopoly Second staff in said gift shop dont seem to care if you fall over dead as long as they get their money as thats obvious in their attitudes Third security personnel have this stupid policy where they check carryon bags AT the gate as planes are being boarded without warning They dont want any unauthorized liquids to be brought on which means that even your carryonfriendly toiletries better be in Ziploc bags thankfully mine were and theyll confiscate your drink bottle that you bought in that unfriendly gift shop for security reasons Yeah I echo the sentiments of some other travelers who have posted in saying Thats stupid Fourth their WiFi ranges from pathetic to nonexisting In all Id far rather fly into and out of Nadi than a lot of major hub airports in the USA but for an otherwise very welcoming Fijian people and culture this airport doesnt have a lot of the Bula spirit

Checkin at BKK very slow with a long line of passengers It took me over an hour to reach the checkin counter The station manager came shrugged her shoulders and left Flight itself on time and uneventful food decent although lukewarm The long hours flight was on the mighty and quiet A Flight left on time and arrived about an hour earlier than scheduled Food was ok but nothing to shout about IFE and complimentary WiFi was very good Seats average in terms of comfort and legroom

Clean and modern Queues at immigration especially when you find no one helping however the immigration officer was polite and friendly Airport is isolated outside Alexandria The only way to go to Alexandria is Taxi who normally abuse that they are the only way to leave the airport and charge too much

The airport is rather old but not badly maintained It is clean Signs are clear given that the configuartion is very unusual being in a slope it is three floors high the gates being in the middle floor There could me more variety when it comes to shops Security was just surprinsingly slow manned by police trays handed to people one by one making it all very slow Not practical at all

Manila is a very crowded and busy airport I have been through here a number of times Its sad that in this day and age you have to lug your bags to a bus to get a connecting flight to Terminal Still I guess it is what it is Bus was crowded and very hot I guess this was to be expected as this was a very busy time when I was traveling Signage has improved a lot since my last visit I was able to find my way to my gate very quickly Always crowded here I feel that they could perhaps improve the air conditioning a little Aside from that little to complain about

The new terminal is finally a leap to the st century egates for brazilians make the process stressless and quick food and drinks limited but good options margaritaville starbucks pizza hut subway etc They take all cards but very expensive though Air con is really strong I would bring a sweater if I were you staff are ok but only speak portuguese foreigners be aware They have installed electric outlets everywhere very nice even in european airports you struggle to find it Overall good experience The new metro does not arrive at airport you have to take a bus to the terminal it is a waiste of time take the direct bus instead much quicker and convenient

Ashgabat is a big airport with very limited traffic Arrived very early in the morning and had to queue at the visa desk which took just on two hours If you dont have a visa prior to arrival you can get one at the airport the process is quite long and takes a lot of time First you queue in the visa line and hand over document and passport Then you queue at the cash desk which can take a lot of time to hand over the money and the tourist tax which everyone has to pay so this line is the busiest once done with that back to the visa desk to get the documents back the cashier desk only accept USD some people had euros which caused some delays They have to be post clean and crisp otherwise they wont accept it They have fingerprint scanners which sometimes work or not Then immigration which the guy was lovely and was very welcoming one of the best immigration experiences I have had in a while Your passport gets checked again before going down the escalator which has an amazing green hand rail Luggage was waiting for me then go through customs and have passport checked again to leave Airport officials will ask for bribes and will charge you if your unlucky they also dont give change Its a cool airport yet its forbidden to take photos which is strange

Modern but slightly odd airport Arrival was easy with aircraft arriving early bags almost beating the passengers to the terminal and out of the building even before plane was due to land Baggage collection area was big and empty being at odds with the rest of the rather cramped airport Bus to the city centre was a local ie a very zigzag route via shopping centre railway station and just about everywhere else Took mins compared with for a taxi but at less than euros it was entertaining interesting from a people watching viewpoint and worth the inconvenience On return to the airport we took a taxi from the hotel in the centre and it was only euros compared with the euros that others were suggesting In the terminal I noticed that the landside area is very narrow and could get crowded if the numbers at the airport increase The departure lounge is also pretty small and oddly enough is accessed straight through a bottleneck of the only shop cafe very small Then there was passport control followed by passengers waiting for the plane but with only about seats All in all modern but surprisingly small

On my first trip to the Amazon in Manaus airport was a nightmare On my second trip the airport had been much upgraded The entire building had been enclosed and was airconditioned many shops some with quality goods

Both arrivals and departures in the new airport are very good The arrivals visa control is very aggressive and unfriendly The passport control is far too slow Departures is good but far from friendly I have an airport lounges pass but was told sorry we havent signed an agreement yet So you have to pay USD each The water dispensers only give hot and warm water why no cold water

Caticlan to El Nido in ATR They rolled a carpet from to the plane to enter and exit Good service in flight on time flight and greeted with umbrellas from the plane to the arrival hall of the airport to avoid the hot sun in El Nido plus for this flight

Nice little airport there are barely any food options just a sushi bar diner convenience stores all pre security the only thing that is post security is a tiny place that has yogurt and granola bars to eat for breakfast No information regarding departing flights Very small cramped and crowded waiting area Upon arrival it took minutes from stepping off the plane to being in my car which includes getting checked bags

Airline checkin at Heathrow was long winded due to current Chinese Govt regulations namely there is no transit available in Shenzhen passengers must clear immigration and customs For nonChinese this necessitates obtaining Chinese day visa on arrival free of charge As I was travelling to Cambodia the airline had to check that visa on arrival was available to me Staff were courteous throughout Despite Covid free certification required for entry into China the airlines are not required to check and nobody in Shenzhen customs or immigration checked for this either Still its a big risk not to have this There is an online Chinese customshealth declaration form that must be completed before arrival in Shenzhen To be blunt this is a total nightmare for people in transit as it asks questions like wherewith whom are you staying in Shenzhen Whats the address Whats the phone number Truly Baffling as you must fill these in Flight to Shenzhen was good Staff were friendly and helpful Food good Beverages were a little limited soft drinks wine and beer More could be obtained on request IFE In Flight Entertainment in English was a little limited just about enough for hour flight The terrible Chinese online health declaration had to be completed again for Shenzhen to Phnom Penh flight Nightmare Smaller Aircraft Snack boxes and beverage No IFE Staff again friendly Shenzhen Airlines websites are terrible No better than useless Customer service via email if youre lucky enough to find one also useless Overall flight very good value for money but its not Air New Zealand or Qatar Airways

The facilities are fine The check in staff at the checkin time is ok When you reach the boarding gate they will make you stand in a queue for an unnecessary check to tick the boarding pass with their pen and then make you wait again The staff at this check point has already interviewed you at the check in counter They have a rude behaviour and tone and not friendly at all

Hailaer Dongshan airport traffic is very inconvenient bus frequency is very few usually have to wait for a long time There are only three automatic checkin machines in the whole terminal which is not very good There are few queues in the manual checkin office and the attitude of the staff in the information office is very good Its not good to go through security only minutes before departure There is no restaurant after the security check The price of the shop is very expensive Its not good Theres free WiFi and its very fast The airport signs are very good The arrival baggage claim area is very narrow and it is very crowded when multiple flights arrive at the same time but the luggage speed is very fast The queuing time of security check is long

Arrive at Alaska air terminal and walked to international Underground tunnels let you skip shuttle bus These are very narrow long and drab and you need bag on rollers Signage is sparse International terminal very crowded and seems duty free oriented Food is limited to very expensive fast fare Enough seating but few places to charge phone Not a great to spend hours but Ive had worse

Beware of the money changers in Batumi Airport In Batumi Airport there are counters of money changers but only one of them is an official counter of the Georgian Bank All the other five give you a buying rate which is lower than the official rate For example instead of Lari Per Euro they will give you Lari Dont be tempted dont go to these money changers Change your Dollar or Euro to Lari in your hotel or in any money change shops on the street there you will get a fair rate

Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Never again will I fly with this airline The plane was so small and super hot inside My seatbelt didnt work as they are supposed too Cabin staff just dont care for customers Just a horrible airline never again will I use it

Yesterday as I arrived at Sint Marteens airport to check in for my transit flight to Antigua with Winair they changed the time without informing any passengers When I brought it to the ladies at the desk I was shut down immediately and pushed aside One of the ladies said they would tell their supervisor and come back to me but she did not My mother called them a plethora of times before they even picked up the call then and only then was arrangements made for me to go back to St kitts and missing my flight in Antigua with inter Caribbean I do not recommend this airline at all

This airport is small but convenient but also quite dated looking It looks like its stuck in the s and seating isnt comfortable Dutyfree is readily available and there are a few small kiosks serving food and beverages Security check is fast and efficient but also looks like how it was done years ago There are different bus services to the city center

IND is my main hub for the last years and its an overall very easy airport to navigate However I wait minutes minimum every time I land here Usually also have to wait minutes sitting yards from the gate before anyone guides the plane in I dont understand how this airport continues to get awards when the basics of bag handling and logistics take so long

Terrible experience checking in I flew from London Vancouver via Toronto and didnt bay baggage for the flight but on the route home I was asked to pay bucks In the grand scheme of things thats fine but they didnt take my credit card and wouldnt take cash or debit I was well within my time of making the flight but got asked if I could go to the currency desk and buy a pre paid card loaded with dollars on but the first counter didnt have any and then I returned to the desk and the lady came to the counter with me and they said they have another counter downstairs in international arrivals By this time Ive walked back and forth and Im made to go to that counter and get this prepaid card which I had to pay another dollars for a processing fee to even get the card The lady was super rude and said if I did not get this I wouldnt be allowed to board my flight This was super stressful and nobody at the check in desk would remotely bothered Paying the dollars wasnt the issue it was the way they handled themselves and made me to be out of doing the airline money They didnt take my credit card cash or debit The flight itself was great and no issues at all The ground staff were the problem

Pretty lacklustre airport with just a handful of standard shops like WHSmiths and Boots The restaurant choice is pretty poor between Frankie and Bennies Starbucks and a burger place The Ryanair check in desk originally had no staff until after around minutes one member came to start checking people in The security process was relatively fast

Memphis is always the city I depart whenever my family decides to go on a trip The service has always been pleasant along with the lowcost airlines it has been adding though after the KLM flight to Amsterdam ended along with Delta dehubbing Memphis MEM has been on a downslope with direct flight routes and still is MEM urgently needs a new international flight although I think MEM could potentially surpass the DeltaKLM days by its amazing service Keep it up MEM

I passed through this airport times during August and September Arrived and Departed for flights to Europe x and Internal flights x I agree with everything recently written but add a few additional points Watch out for the Euro coin scammers Locals trying to exchange euro coins for notes They will show you Euros in coins and ask for a note in exchange They are expert at a sleight of hand confidence trick You will not get the correct change once they count it out for you There is a cafe on the first floor of international departures that is open x and is the only nonairside seating area Particularly useful if your flight is delayed and are awaiting check in to open The Duty Free was open until am for the Air France Paris flight I flew Kenyan Airlines to Nairobi this was a flight originating in Mozambique or Reunion but assigned seat was not available as the transiting passengers were already stretched out over all seats It ended up as a free for all for the remaining free seats

Flew from Ribeirao Preto RAO to Sao Paulo GRU Passerado flies local routes around Brasil I have used them on numerous occasions and I have found them to be just a budget airline with very few extras They have now gone down even further in my opinion for two main reasons The excess baggage fees have increased to maximise as much profit as possible It used to be R per Kilo Now its a whopping R per Kilo This fee can vary from where you are flying from so expect to pay more up to R from some airports Most people use the airline for either business or a holiday destinations so the bag of KG per person is nothing for a small family wanting to get away Its profit all the way with this company On board you will get nothing to eat and the in flight drink will be a cup of water with lumps of ice

The airport is currently being reconstructed but this is done in quite an absurd way All gates are cramped into temporary low ceiling housing with a way too big dutyfree store in the middle Early afternoon most planes depart meaning the place is completely packed Airconditioning has to be set to the max to keep cool Definitely wear a facemask to avoid any respiratory illness The arrival is fine at the old terminal building and is equally outdated either Passport control and security checks are done efficiently though
Long queues to get through immigration and then a very long walk to the metro The airport looked reasonable enough with sufficient shopseateries etc Arrival was ok but could have been better

Flew through Harare International several times during a recent trip to Zimbabwe using both the Domestic International terminals The current Domestic terminal was the International one until a few years ago no updating has been done since as the customs immigration desks are all still there It was quick to pass through and pleasantly decorated however there was a distinct lack of facilities only a few domestic flights each day so it probably hasnt been worth their while putting shops etc in and the toilets were in dismal condition to be avoided at all costs International terminal was a much better experience Opened only a few years ago and built for a much larger number of flights than it currently handles it seemed very spacious Facilities were all wellmaintained with a good range of shops Food in the only restaurant was also good Customs and immigration checks both arriving and departing were quick courteous Overall a very pleasant airport for international flights but let down by their poorlymaintained domestic facilities

I like this little airport its actually one of my favourites but they cant cope at busy times am on Saturday December three internal flights leaving within minutes of each other huge queue to get baggage dropped and scanned by one machine Equally huge queue though security Just made flight despite arriving well before advertised bagdrop time No time to see or do anything

This airline deserves zero stars The staff is unaccommodating and they will check everyones bags to make sure they are to the size of there requirements and will make sure to charge you extra at every chance

I was sceptical after reading the reviews but I could not be happier with the flight Staff were polite and attentive left on time and landed mins earlier Airplane was new and very clean I will use them again Only issue I had is the website that shows I know errors and had to call to ask for clarifications and also to receive the confirmation email

Very good experience Arriving Plane lands bags come off quickly and arrive quickly passport line mins maximum with all desks open with very little queues Departing All check in desks were open which made it flow quick security lines were short which means we were through within minutes Good shops and restaurants available

Good job of Icelandair Our flight was cancelled day of the flight due to weather issues We got rebooked to the next day We had to rebook hotel and had additional stress the day of But after returning Icelandair was relatively quick to issue a full compensation and reimbursed us for hotel and meal Thank you

It was a very unpleasant experience at Bridgetown airport while arrival was still acceptable the departure was a nightmare The counters for check in are opening later as the announced time on the tickets very long queue for security and no fast track however it seemed passengers from a particular cruise line with some passengers from the UK did obtain priority Officers doing the security were extremely unpolite and very disrespectful shouting to passengers as a drill sergeant to recruits give them a uniform and they all think they are important Restrooms not clean at all boarding the plane was chaotic

Took two domestic flights on Air Bagan one from Yangon to Bagan and another Mandalay to Yangon Both flights were with ATR aircraft The interior of this aircraft was very cramped with hardly any leg space The aircraft definitely showed its old age The flight from Mandalay to Yangon was free seated and flight was completely full The inflight service was nice and they served savoury croissants and cakes with drinks Regarding reservations the booking system is fairly tricky Also the airline requires the passenger to confirm the flights at least hours before departures Yet the phone lines are constantly busy For both flights our hotels repeatedly tried calling to no avail Air Bagan offers value for money because there is hardly any competitive alternative today

Sign posting is an absolute nightmare Half of terminal is separated from the other no way to get to the other side unless theyre nice enough to let you through some little bottleneck boarding pass scanner In our case they werent We were made to go outside of the secure area reenter through security screening circumnavigate the whole of terminal just to end up back right where we started With the exception of being on the right side of some plexiglass Took us minutes to accomplish this Just to get to the spot we were literally looking at through a window Not even feet away This journey gives you no sense of confidence in others advice because you are following signs exclusively for terminal At the end of your trek across the whole airport you finally see signage for terminal A couple minutes later youve arrived at your gate

Pleasant and unmemorable for all the right reasons no excessive queues no overcrowding just a good efficient airport doing what airports are meant to do ie processing passengers swiftly and without hassle in an attractive environment Some parts of DRS particularly the LH check in reminded me of a smaller version of HAM I agree with Mr Evans that DRS is underutilised although at least that means there is plenty of space for everyone
Not enough seating for eating or at the gate Bathroom facilities woefully lacking Not enough and lacking in hygiene Not impressed compared to other European airports

Its a newly built airport in Sialkot operates international flights to various destinations around the globe Staff are local and helpful Entrance to the airport car park may take a bit longer but that is due to security checks at the entrance as the airport is located near Sambrial city and security staff allows only one attendant with each passenger some locals use this opportunity as a picnic spot which is unnecessary

This airline may be good for smallshort trips inside Colombia but their service for international flights is very poor I booked a round trip flight for my elderly grandmother from Bogota to JFK they dont offer anything on board you have to buy your own food which is normal for flights inside the US but not for international flights On her way back they left her suitcase behind along with another suitcases because they had more than they could carry and they promised her luggage will be available for pickup on the next day Well its been almost a week and now they dont even know where her luggage is their call center and other employees havent been helpful throughout the whole ordeal Ill not use this airline again or recommend it to anyboody if you book your flight with enough time you can get great deals from the other airlines that are much much better that Aires

Gatwick to Santorini hr delay going out but flight was reasonably pleasant staff friendly and the plane appeared to be reasonably new Coming back we had the joy of a hr delay The delay itself wasnt too grim it was during the day and was spent in a taverna up the road from the airport rather than the tiny departure lounge We eventually left on a plane which had clearly been sourced in a hurry that looked like it was the only one in the scrapyard that still worked Luckily we arrived back in the UK in one piece and this is where the fun begins Dont expect a quick response to any delay claims weeks will pass Dont expect to be offered the full amount as stated in the regulations on flight delays Dont expect to receive the payout within the time limit they state weeks in our case its now weeks since they promised a payout and over months since the claim was first placed Dont expect to get a response to any chasing emails They ignore Tweets too The only response I got on social media was posting to their FB wall along with many other disgruntled customers you cant post directly to the wall you have to put a comment in one of their posts Despite the actual flights being OK staff are lovely there is no way I would ever fly with Small Planet again They suffer badly from delays and their customer service is one of the worst Ive encountered Id rather walk to my destination it would probably be quicker

The food was ok and the crew were very nice The drinks were good and the seat reclines into a fullflat bed There are blankets and pillows provided You also get an amenity kit The lavatories were ok nothing special There is no WiFi onboard Food couldve been better

Except the Air India counter staff member this airport is an absolute nightmare The executive lounge does not even have WiFi access Planes are delayed and its not really clean To sum up they call this an international airport I call it an onlydomestic one

AdenDubai on A Checkin swift and airside in less than mins Flight overbooked caused delay as ground staff sorted out rebookings for disgruntled pax Boarding was mildly confusing as some pax did not respect seat assignments Crew did their best to sort it out and finally got my seat Seat pitch tight for someone over cm limited seat recline good enough for h min flight would have been worse for longhaul Video on safety procedures was running during takeoff Light meal served after takeoff Good selection of juices though only one drink offered Cabin fairly clean but hygiene of restrooms questionable Rule on mobile phone use not enforced by crew and several pax out of their seats emptying overhead bins while taxiing to stand at Dubai quite chaotic

Bag drop didnt open until late was meant to open at didnt open until for a flight meanwhile all flights for easyJet were queuing for just bag drop desks Security was somewhat chaotic the instructions have gotten less and less clear all electricals to come out despite signage saying put small items watches phones etc in hand luggage causing significant delays passing through security After passing security food choices are extremely limited there are many concessions offering a broadly identical menu ham and cheese sandwiches or cheese and tomato or ham some had tuna but looked particularly unappealing on the cheap and sweet local sliced bread There is also a Burger King but it was too busy owing to the aforementioned issues Subsequently UK passport holders were made to wait for the egates for another half hour while eu passport holders were prioritised for the same flights I have visited Gran Canaria some times in years and never seen chaos like this And frankly would make me carefully consider whether I return

Wagga Wagga is a regional airport serving a town of All was good except that our flight was delayed due to Sydney weather thats not an issue but the snack bar closed during the hour wait There is a soft drink vending machine but nothing for food or snacks Oddly there were instant coffee and sugar sachets on the tables but no hot water Large plasma screens whiled away the time and there were enough seats to stretch out and have a nap Its the home base of REX Regional Express Airline a snack machine and hot water would be good

Pretty poor airport Lack of almost all facilities except a single store ATM and toilets Theres free wifi but you only get half an hour You can buy beer from the store but you arent allowed to drink it on the seats immediately outside Coach to Stockholm city centre is a typical tourist trap rip off just catch the local bus SEK and then a train from Nykping SEK possibly cheaper if booked in advance Calling this Stockholm Skavsta airport is the equivalent of a Birmingham London airport Needs to be better signposted You may also get harrassed by borderairport security like I did if you only have hand luggage because apparently that looks suspicious Just save yourself the effort and fly to Arlanda main city airport instead

Flew with Sunwing from Toronto to Sa nta Clara on March rd to April th Brought an extra luggage to leave to the Cubans at the resort therefore it was only for one way Was told there was a dollar change but was changed dont understand why Other than that our trip was amazing Have MS therefore have problem with stairs Was provided with a Wheel chair and a lift to the plane Booked with Sunwing to the same resort Royalton Cayo Santa Maria for October th for weeks Will be bringing an extra suitcase one way again Hope I dont run into the same problem
The change our flight twice same day extremely unreliable and very poor costumer services Good luck if you are traveling with kids and seniors they will be miserable

Small clean airport easy to get round however you are forced to pay with zero exception a euro per passenger development fee so travelling as a family you are rinsed for euro so that they can supposedly build a new runway or improve security however zero work was being done so where does this money go I wonder Clearly the only airline flying today RyanAir refused to pay and so lumps the passengers with it Ill not be flying from here again and I wouldnt have flown via here if I knew that when booking my ticket clearly Ryan Air keep that a nice little secret

ADD Bole airport is a zoo On our outbound flight we arrived from London and passed through security and from there to the lounge and boarded the plane to VFA On the way back having been through security at VFA and again during transit at ADD we had to go through security again near the gate Not only that we then had a secondary screening and two lots of document checks With three flights leaving within minutes of each other having one person looking at documents of people is just bonkers I can see why people miss flights at this airport if youre not aware of this If you are leaving from gates A inclusive which seems to be the only part of the airport where this happens you need to leave a good minutes in addition to whatever time you think you need to get to the actual gate
